title: The US raises censorship concerns over the UK's proposals to force tech platforms to put "trustworthy" news providers at the top of social and video feeds (Charlotte Tobitt/Press Gazette)
summary: Charlotte Tobitt / Press Gazette: The US raises censorship concerns over the UK's proposals to force tech platforms to put “trustworthy” news providers at the top of social and video feeds — News Media Association warns forcing prominence for ‘trustworthy’ news could end up harming sector.
contentText:
Charlotte Tobitt / Press Gazette :

The US raises censorship concerns over the UK's proposals to force tech platforms to put “trustworthy” news providers at the top of social and video feeds   —  News Media Association warns forcing prominence for ‘trustworthy’ news could end up harming sector.
